working_definition: Adult salivary gland cells (mostly in the Malpighian tubule analysis; Li et al. 2022; author term FBbt:00003135; broad class gland).

best_match.fbbt_definition: Any epithelial cell (FBbt:00000124) that is part of some adult salivary gland (FBbt:00003135).

justification: Organ named; the cell-level equivalent is adult salivary gland epithelial cell (parent of the secretory cell). Gland cells are epithelial.
